items.reason: The Control Tower inventory endpoint returns an unscoped list. No authorized count or coverage denominator is adopted here.
Agent enrollments expose last check-in times. Freshness thresholds, authorized scope, and historical series require a reviewed source contract.
A current status query and an updated-at filter cannot reconstruct historical state. A governed historical source is required.
The existing match APIs require an approved definition for what counts as current exposure and how distinct affected assets are deduplicated.
Verification history exists. The cohort, denominator, time window, and eligible verification outcomes have not been approved as a metric.
